newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Merchants '96 net 100 mln yuan.
newsitem.headline: China Merchants '96 net 100 mln yuan.

text.p: China Merchants Shekou Port Service Co Ltd reaped net profits of 100.16 million yuan in 1996, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange said in a notice after the market closed on Tuesday.
Earnings per share were 0.31 yuan in 1996 and turnover reached 1.82 billion yuan, the exchange said.
It did not specify whether the results were compiled under Chinese or international accounting standards and gave no comparative figures.
For 1995, the company posted net profits of 120.98 million yuan based on international accounting standards.
Based on Chinese standards, 1995 net profits were 125.56 million yuan.
The firm proposed no dividend for 1996, the exchange said.
Trading in the company's A and B shares will be suspended on Wednesday morning and resume in the afternoon, it said.
